risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and well quantified, but includes substantial standard MD&A and forward-looking-statement boilerplate. Credit risk is elevated by a 2019 net loss, materially higher depreciation from residual-value revisions, negative free cash flow, rising debt, and a 320% debt-to-equity ratio. Operating cash flow remained strong, but leverage and fleet-related capital intensity create meaningful sensitivity to vehicle values, demand, costs, and financing conditions.
